# imagined

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:originImagined`](gmeow-originImagined.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/originImagined>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/imagination`](../../slices/imagination.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Content GENERATED BY IMAGINING — entertained quasi-perceptually as-if ([`gmeow:imagines`](../properties/gmeow-imagines.md); the occurrent face is a [`gmeow:processImagining`](gmeow-processImagining.md), mentation, by reference). The internally-generated source; mistaking imagined content for perceived or remembered is the canonical confabulation, which this marker exists to flag.

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:ContentOrigin`](../classes/gmeow-ContentOrigin.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:originImagined`](gmeow-originImagined.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:ContentOrigin`](../classes/gmeow-ContentOrigin.md).
